name: Gosti iz budushchego
source:
The universe of this story is based on a mix of the "Everlasting Summer" setting, as well as the worlds from the book "One Hundred Years Ahead" and the movie "Guest from the Future", but it only minimally resembles the latter.

The story begins in the middle of a three-week pioneer camp shift. The grumbling protagonist, Nikolai Gerasimov, who hates wasting time, works at the camp as a club leader alongside Elektronik and Shurik.

Instead of the usual squad, there is a team of Olga Dmitrievna's subordinates. The characters are not pioneers, but people doing part-time work at the camp. Almost all the characters are eighteen years old.

Eventful days lie ahead, spiced up with various happenings and interesting activities. The cherry on top will be the guys' new colleague, Alisa Selezneva, who is in charge of these activities. After this, the protagonist realizes why he really ended up here. Is this really a camp? Is Alisa really new? Is Nikolai really just here for a part-time job?

Who knows what will happen next? One minute you're drinking tea in cheerful company, and a few minutes later you're fighting to the death.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1707032907]Steam[/url]]
